title: Project Babel Observatory Taxonomy
description: Canonical label registry and versioning metadata for Project Babel AI governance extraction, framing classification, and source manifests (Taxonomy v2.1.0).

taxonomy_version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) of the canonical taxonomy.

schema_version.description: Schema format version governing the taxonomy JSON layout.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 calendar date of the latest taxonomy revision.

versioning_policy.description: Human-readable compatibility and semantic-versioning rules for taxonomy changes.

document_types.description: Structural class of an official publication.

binding_strength.description: Legal or supervisory force carried by a document.

issuer_types.description: Institutional class of an issuing authority or official portal.

source_tiers.description: Normative hierarchy tier used for coverage planning and tier-weighted scoring.

corpus_roles.description: Analytical role distinguishing active primary instruments from companions, drafts, and historical baselines.

lifecycle_stages.description: Current legal or operational status of a document.

policy_requirements.description: Concrete safety, governance, transparency, or operational requirements extracted from official texts.

obligation_strengths.description: Deontic modality of an extracted requirement (mandatory, conditional, recommended, aspirational).

enforcement_mechanisms.description: Sanctions, supervisory hooks, and compliance levers referenced in official texts.

application_domains.description: Regulated AI application sectors and system classes covered by a document.

risk_framings.description: Fixed eight-label rationale vocabulary measuring why governments justify AI governance.
